description:
Bring the market context already tracked in LMTY into your AI conversations. Explore competitors, review pricing, packaging, products and positioning, and see how your market has evolved, with supporting evidence and observation dates behind the findings.

Start from research and history you already have instead of rebuilding the context for every task. Use it to prepare for a competitive deal, review your positioning, investigate a market shift or quickly catch up on a competitor.

defaultPrompt: What pricing and packaging information is available for my competitors? Include the latest evidence and observation dates.
Use the competitive deep dive skill to profile one closest competitor, including positioning, pricing, products, and evidence.
